correctness.rationale: Independently re-implemented bitmask power-automaton BFS (forward from Q and reverse from singletons via preimages) in a fresh script. Witness a=(1,2,3,4,5,0,7,7), b=(0,5,6,3,6,1,2,4): indeg_a=[1,1,1,1,1,1,0,2], indeg_b=[1,1,1,1,1,1,2,0] so Eulerian holds; b is not a permutation; forward=reverse=25; claimed word bbaabaababbaaababaabaaaab has length 25 and replays Q.w={6}; pair-merging (Eppstein) test passes; underlying digraph strongly connected; BFS first-reach by subset size = {8:0,7:1,6:2,5:4,4:7,3:10,2:17,1:25}, matching DRAFT compression profile; 174 reachable subsets. Ran candidate scripts: verify_witness.py and bfs2.py agree (rt=25, Cerny sanity (n-1)^2 for n=3..8 all match). Table 1 witnesses for n=4..7 all replay to claimed rt (5,10,14,22) under both BFS codes and pass Eulerian check. Brute-forced ALL Eulerian pairs for n=2 (6 pairs, Emax=1), n=3 (90 pairs, Emax=2), n=4 (2520 pairs, Emax=5), n=5 (113400 pairs, Emax=10) with independent code: all match claimed E(n). Validated the AHU reduction: AHU-code partition equals brute-force S_n canonical-orbit partition exhaustively for n=4 (19/19 groups, 0 mismatches) and n=6 (130/130, 0 mismatches) plus published n=5 check; sampled n=7 (4000 random valid a-maps, 2092 same-AHU collisions, all pairs genuinely isomorphic by brute perm search, 0 false collisions). Fiber-need counting reproduces DRAFT run totals 222/1980/23580. Re-ran exact_E.py for n=7 end-to-end: 164 AHU reps, 301770 BFS runs, global max 22 with the two claimed witnesses (only the JSON write failed due to cwd-relative path when run from workspace root; computation itself completed). Independently re-enumerated the n=8 spine fiber with distinct-multiset backtracking (not set(permutations)): 20160 completions, 19296 synchronizing, max 25 at (0,5,6,3,6,1,2,4), forward/reverse agree on every synchronizing case (0 disagreements). Minor non-material defect noted: DRAFT quotes Kari Eulerian bound as n^2-3n+4=44 at n=8; the published Kari/Volkov bound is (n-1)(n-2)+1=n^2-3n+3=43 at n=8. The claimed inequality 25<=44 remains true and no theorem depends on the constant; RESULT.md records 43.

originality.rationale: Checked living survey Volkov arXiv:2508.15655 (v4, item A6 Eulerian automata): upper bound n^2-3n+3 (Kari), lower bound floor((n^2-3)/2) via Szykula-Vorel quaternary series, Szykula-Vorel conjecture, Martyugin unpublished binary odd-n series conjectured (n^2-5)/2 confirmed by search for n=5,7,9,11 only, and best published binary lower bound (n^2-3n+4)/2. No binary-Eulerian exact-maximum table entry exists. Checked Szykula-Vorel arXiv:1604.02879 full text: extremal series is quaternary (alphabet {alpha,beta,omega0,omega1}), N=4m+1 states, rt=(N^2-3)/2; Section 5 exhaustive search verified the (n^2-3)/2 UPPER bound for binary n<=11 / quaternary n<=7 etc., but publishes no exact E(n) table for the binary Eulerian family and no binary 8-state rt=25 witness (their binary discussion concerns the odd-n Martyugin series at (n^2-5)/2, confirmed only for odd n=5,7,9,11). Checked Kisielewicz-Kowalski-Szykula arXiv:1607.04025 (binary n<=12 Cerny verification) and Kowalski-Szykula arXiv:1301.2092: general-binary censuses with no Eulerian-family separation or maxima. Checked Vorel arXiv:1409.2003: NP-completeness of bounded reset for binary Eulerian automata (complexity only, no extremals). arXiv searches for 'binary Eulerian reset', 'Martyugin reset Eulerian', and reset-threshold/Eulerian/exact-small returned no binary-Eulerian extremal table. Substantive delta: (i) first exact binary-Eulerian maxima E(1..7)=(0,1,2,5,10,14,22) by isomorphism-complete BFS; (ii) even-n binary Eulerian 8-state witness with rt=25, exceeding the Gusev-type binary bound (n^2-3n+4)/2=22 at n=8 and the sink-family benchmark (23-24 depending on variant), outside the odd-n Martyugin series; (iii) 20160-case fiber-optimality certificate for its one-cluster spine. Not a timestamp/failed-search claim and not a parameter bump of n<=12 verification.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later: closes the binary-Eulerian slice of the Kari vs Szykula-Vorel gap at small n with citable finite certificates. The E(n) table for n<=7 is a new exact enumeration (replayable in seconds: 222 to 301770 BFS runs), the rt=25 witness is the strongest known even-n binary Eulerian extremal at n=8 with two-code BFS certificate plus explicit 25-letter reset word and compression profile, and the spine fiber-optimality (all 20160 completions exhausted, max 25) is a complete optimality proof for a natural 20160-case stratum. Beats the textbook binary sink benchmark (n^2/4+2n-9=23; Volkov variant ceil(n^2/4+3n/2-4)=24) in both variants. Explicitly refrains from claiming global E(8)=25, so value does not depend on the unclosed exhaustion. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: methods (canonical-a reduction + fiber exhaustion + two-code BFS agreement + Cerny sanity) and witnesses are fully specified and reproduced.
